candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware relaxation with downstream protection. When total pipeline is high relative to recent delivered demand, trim orders modestly, but only if local backlog is low; if backlog is high, add a small amount to protect service. Uses only observed state, no event timing.

Backlog-service coordination. Raise orders when backlog is large and pipeline is thin, but cap increases; reduce only when pipeline clearly exceeds demand and backlog is zero. Small deltas limit overreaction to miscalibrated forecasts.

Growth-adaptive damping using delayed delivered reports. If recent delivered demand exceeds baseline and pipeline is thin, add a small amount; if pipeline is excessive relative to recent, trim cautiously. Guards avoid division and keep corrections bounded.

rules.when: growth > 1.15 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0
growth < 0.85 and pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog < 1
